lines.t: I walked the valley, lost in gray
Chasing echoes that slipped away
But then I saw the sky ignite
The Voice of Truth, the endless Light
You called my name through wind and flame
And now I live to praise Your name
YahuShua, You lift my soul
From chains of night to fields of gold
Every tear becomes a sign
Of mercy’s hand, of love divine
In Your Word, my heart awakes
Through every trial, the darkness breaks
The lowly rise, the weary sing
For in Your breath, creation rings
You split the sea that bound my mind
And left my fear so far behind
YahuShua, You lift my soul
From chains of night to fields of gold
Every tear becomes a sign
Of mercy’s hand, of love divine
The heavens roar, the Kingdom nears
Your promise wipes away all tears
No shadow stands, no pain remains
Glory lives where You have reigned
YahuShua, my heart restored
Forever Yours, forever more
Light of lights, my hope, my song
The Lamb will reign, His truth lives on
I am found, I am reborn
In You, Messiah, I am home
The dawn has come, the veil is torn
All praise to You, the Rising Sun
